name: Shodh: The Pursuit of Truth
overview:
Shodh: The Pursuit of Truth

is an Indian detective crime thriller web series that follows investigator Arjun and his team as they uncover hidden truths behind crimes rooted in everyday society. From cyber fraud and workplace harassment to marriage scams and psychological deception, And Much More each episode explores a different case inspired by real-world issues. As the investigations deepen, the team faces moral dilemmas, digital threats, and dangerous confrontations in their relentless pursuit of justice.
